newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cosmos acquires 173 mln peso cola plant.
newsitem.headline: Cosmos acquires 173 mln peso cola plant.

text.p: Cosmos Bottling Corp, a subsidiary of RFM Corp, said on Tuesday it has purchased a 173-million peso cola bottling facility in Laguna, south of Manila.
RFM president Jose Concepcion III said in a statement that the acquisition of a cola plant is part of the company's plans to expand production capacity by at least 30 percent yearly.
The plant was acquired from competitor RC Cola which phased out its operations in Luzon.
Cosmos chief operating officer Antonio Panajon said that Cosmos' rapid volume growth proves that it has gained acceptance in a market dominated by foreign brand softdrinks.
He said net sales of the company rose by more than 32 percent last year to 1.2 billion pesos.
